content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the previous commit (77469c3f570) which incorrectly prevented the page from being marked as uptodate when the correct amount of data was written. This led to situations where the page remained marked as not uptodate even after a successful write operation, causing inconsistencies in the page state. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the page is set to uptodate when the full page size is written, thus fixing the issue.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the previous commit (77469c3f570) which incorrectly prevented the page from being marked as uptodate when the correct amount of data was written. This led to situations where the page remained marked as not uptodate even after a successful write operation, causing inconsistencies in the page state. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the page is set to uptodate when the full page size is written, thus fixing the issue.
Patch:
From 56ae414e9d2718bcbfda9ba3797c39005e2f90fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Levin <alexander.levin@verizon.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Apr 2017 18:46:51 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] 9p: set page uptodate when required in write_end()

Commit 77469c3f570 prevented setting the page as uptodate when we wrote
the right amount of data, fix that.

Fixes: 77469c3f570 ("9p: saner ->write_end() on failing copy into non-uptodate page")
Reviewed-by: Jan Kara <jack@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: Alexander Levin <alexander.levin@verizon.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>
---
 fs/9p/vfs_addr.c | 10 +++++++---
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/fs/9p/vfs_addr.c b/fs/9p/vfs_addr.c
index adaf6f6dd858..e1cbdfdb7c68 100644
--- a/fs/9p/vfs_addr.c
+++ b/fs/9p/vfs_addr.c
@@ -310,9 +310,13 @@ static int v9fs_write_end(struct file *filp, struct address_space *mapping,
 
 	p9_debug(P9_DEBUG_VFS, "filp %p, mapping %p\n", filp, mapping);
 
-	if (unlikely(copied < len && !PageUptodate(page))) {
-		copied = 0;
-		goto out;
+	if (!PageUptodate(page)) {
+		if (unlikely(copied < len)) {
+			copied = 0;
+			goto out;
+		} else if (len == PAGE_SIZE) {
+			SetPageUptodate(page);
+		}
 	}
 	/*
 	 * No need to use i_size_read() here, the i_size
